verdict.rationale: The Jobs API documents an opt-in diarization option that adds a speaker_id to each transcript segment based on voice. It also documents a channel-based speaker mode for multi-track recordings, so a developer can request diarization and get segment-level speaker labels. Documentation is only one-line parameter descriptions with no example output or tuning details. missing for 10: documented output schema/example showing speaker labels, speaker-count or tuning controls, word-level speaker attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration of diarization accuracy

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: When enabled, adds speaker_id to each segment based on the speaker's voice.
When enabled, parses speakers from multi-channel audio by assigning one speaker per channel.
